name: Myanmar
value: Airstrike on Rakhine camp killed 12 on 13 Nov
summary: Military airstrikes continue in Rakhine, including a 13 Nov strike on a displaced persons camp that killed 12
state: A military airstrike on the Byar La displaced persons camp in Ponnagyun township, Rakhine State, killed 12 people and injured 18 on 13 Nov, witnesses and a rescue group told AFP (New Straits Times). Anadolu reported military airstrikes killed at least 15 civilians in the same period, 12 of them in Rakhine. Airstrikes on civilian areas in Rakhine remain frequent; searches on 23 Nov found no major city changing hands and no cross-border escalation, so Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to much of Myanmar, including Rakhine State. Civilians in conflict areas face frequent airstrikes and displacement.
rubric_hit: Civil war at sustained intensity = Watch; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation
